name: Whispers Through the Wall
source:
When Maria meets a stranger on her balcony, her winter holidays grow a little warmer… This project is a short otome game featuring themes of loneliness and self-discovery. It has a single love interest named Jamie, a young chef who is between jobs.

[From [url=https://tidalblossoms.itch.io/whispers-through-the-wall]Itch.io[/url]]
